xmldoc.short_description: Display an image as a texture mapped onto a surface.

param_input_item.param_description: Surface coordinates. X and Y may be vectors or matrices; Z is a matrix. When omitted (warp(Z, A) forms), X and Y are built from the size of Z.
Image mapped onto the surface: an indexed (M-by-N) image or a truecolor (M-by-N-by-3) image. Its size is independent of the surface grid.
Colormap (P-by-3) used when A is an indexed image. It is applied to the current axes.

param_output_item.param_description: Handle of the created surface object.

description.p: Display the image A texture mapped onto the surface defined by X, Y and Z.
The image is mapped per fragment, so it stays crisp regardless of how coarse the surface grid is; its resolution is independent of the number of surface points.
The created surface uses FaceColor set to texturemap, EdgeColor set to none and CDataMapping set to direct. The axes are displayed with a reversed Y direction and a default 3-D view.
This is equivalent to creating a surface and setting its FaceColor property to texturemap with the image as CData.

example_item.example_item_description: Warp a color gradient onto a dome
